sandbachFocus: Sandbach United travel to Cheadle Heath Nomads on Saturday in what appears a winnable fixture. Sandbach sit 2nd with 18 points from 8 games and arrive in excellent form with four consecutive wins. Cheadle Heath are bottom-half strugglers occupying 18th place with just 5 points, having lost their last three matches, making this a good opportunity for Sandbach to maintain their momentum.
divisionWide: The title race sees AFC Bridgnorth (1st, 19 points) host Widnes Town in a fixture that should see Bridgnorth extend their lead; Widnes are bottom with just 2 points and have won none of their six games. Stafford Town, currently 4th with 16 points, face Alsager Town (20th, 4 points), another winnable encounter for the hosts. In-form Eccleshall (3rd, 18 points) are notably absent from this weekend's fixtures. New Mills (6th, 14 points) play Market Drayton Town (12th, 9 points) in a mid-table clash. Bilston Town (8th, 11 points) face Widnes Town in what could be a tight affair between struggling sides. Wednesfield Community (10th, 10 points) host Allscott Heath (17th, 5 points), a fixture between mid and lower-table teams. Dawley Town (14th, 7 points) play Brereton Social (15th, 7 points) in a direct battle between two of the division's poorest-performing sides.
